propositions: The current clarity measure awards points for volume and legacy per-type shape (H2 headings, character thresholds, bullets) rather than verifying the author-guide leaf/container contract, allowing padded tickets to pass without required sections.

Required-section checks keyed on graph altitude (Context/Problem + AC for all plans; Approach + Scope for leaves; AC + decomposition for containers) must replace generic length/bullet bonuses and be parsed once to prevent drift between gates.py and det_floor.py.

Per-AC verification coverage should mandate explicit proving clauses (operator-attested, verified by, checked by) or command/artifact references for each checkbox item, reported as a ratio and treated advisory until corpus validation.

Placeholder lexicon (TBD, figure out, verify whether, depends on investigation, choose an appropriate X) must be deterministically detected and case-insensitive in Scope/Approach to penalize deferred decisions.

AC text hygiene checks (bundled outcomes, subjective terms, hedges like should/probably) and Testing shape checks (happy-path and failure/edge markers) must reuse P6 signals without inferring applicability deterministically.
Scoring must derive from named applicable checks with per-check evidence rather than accumulating points to a fixed scale, so that missing required sections cannot be compensated by filler.
